#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n;
    cin >> s;
    
    // Replace underscores with spaces
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            size_t j = i;
            while (j < s.length() && s[j] == '_') j++;
            s.replace(i, j-i, " ");
            i = i + 1;
        }
    }
    
    string fuck;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            fuck += " ( ";
        } else if (s[i] == ')') {
            fuck += " ) ";
        } else {
            fuck += s[i];
        }
    }
    s = fuck;
    
    vector<string> a;
    stringstream ss(s);
    string token;
    while (ss >> token) {
        a.push_back(token);
    }
    
    bool is = false;
    int max_len = 0, c = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        if (a[i].find('(') != string::npos) {
            is = true;
        } else if (a[i].find(')') != string::npos) {
            is = false;
        } else {
            if (is) {
                c++;
            } else {
                max_len = max(max_len, (int)a[i].length());
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << max_len << " " << c << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
